name: BankJar
tagline: Rank Spanish bank offers by first-year net value.
summary: One table, one formula, every catch and source. Open code, open data, MCP for agents.

highlights.label: SEARCH
highlights.title: Ask in plain words
highlights.text: AI search, with a rule parser as fallback, turns a goal into a ranked table.

highlights.label: SCALE
highlights.title: One first-year net scale
highlights.text: Every reward and rate lands on the same euro value, from one open formula.

highlights.label: COMPARE
highlights.title: Side by side
highlights.text: Put two or three offers next to each other, with every catch and source.

highlights.label: APPS
highlights.title: 24 bank apps ranked
highlights.text: Scored 0 to 100 on ratings, freshness, reach and Bizum or Apple Pay.

highlights.label: DATA
highlights.title: Open, dated data
highlights.text: One YAML file per offer, CC BY 4.0, with a source link and a verified date.

highlights.label: AGENTS
highlights.title: Built for agents
highlights.text: JSON API, OpenAPI, llms.txt and a remote MCP server. No key needed.

steps.title: Ask
steps.text: Type a goal: salary, savings, account, deposit or bonus.

steps.title: Parse
steps.text: AI or a rule parser turns the words into a profile.

steps.title: Rank
steps.text: One engine scores every offer in first-year net euros.

steps.title: Check
steps.text: Read each catch, then open the bank's own source link.
